{{Quote|Thing was one of the Empire's new diamond-boron-armored jobs.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], about the MS-15 diamond boron missile|<ref name="SotE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
'''Boron''' was a [[Gas/Legends|gas]] that could be found in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the barren and [[Temperature/Legends|hot]] [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Acilaris]]. It could be used to manufacture [[Boron power generator|power generators]], such as those present on [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], and [[boron fission reactor]]s, including ones used to power [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] emplacements. The [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] also produced [[carbonite-boron mid-gauge mining bit]]s. Another use for boron was in the production of [[Missile/Legends|missiles]], with [[diamond boron missile]]s such as the [[MS-15 diamond boron missile]] being designed for use against [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. [[Diamond/Legends|Diamond]] boron [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plates rendered that specific model nearly impervious to [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]; however, the [[Weapon/Legends|weapon's]] high cost prohibited its widespread use.

==Description==
Boron was a light [[Gas/Legends|gas]] that was present in trace quantities in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of<ref name="Acilaris" /> the barren rock<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Acilaris]]. Small and possessing a very high surface [[Temperature/Legends|temperature]], Acilaris occupied the closest [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around<ref name="Acilaris" /> the [[Binary star/Legends|binary star]] [[Morasil]] and [[Termadus]] of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]<ref name="LFCG" /> in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Thaere sector/Legends|Thaere sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

==History==
===Mining bits and power generation===
{{Quote|Vespula, a 12-year old company, was in violation of several patent and copyright laws when it began unlicensed replication of carbonite-boron mid-gauge mining bits.|HoloNet News report|<ref name="HNN" />}}
[[File:Shantipole_Research_Station.png|thumb|left|300px|Boron power generators were used on Verpine colony asteroids such as Research Station Shantipole.]]
The company [[Vespula Manufacturing & Exports]], based in the [[Kalinda system/Legends|Kalinda system]]<ref name="HNN" /> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Vilonis sector/Legends|Vilonis sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> at one point began manufacturing unlicensed replicas of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild's]] [[carbonite-boron mid-gauge mining bit]]s, thereby violating several patent and copyright laws. After three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of ignored warnings to cease the illegal activities, the Commerce Guild employed a team of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] that destroyed Vespula's [[Factory/Legends|manufacturing plants]], with the termination of the unlicensed [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-boron mid-gauge mining bits subsequently being reported on in a news report of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News']] [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[22 BBY/Legends|13:5:2]].<ref name="HNN" />

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], boron was also used in the manufacture of [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]]<ref name="Shantipole" /> and [[Nuclear fission|fission]] [[Reactor/Legends|reactors]].<ref name="IS2" /> Most [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] of the [[Roche system]]'s [[Roche asteroid field|asteroid field]]<ref name="Shantipole" /> in the Mid Rim's [[Roche sector/Legends|Roche sector]]<ref name="EAOC Roche">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Roche system]]</ref>&mdash;including [[Research Station Shantipole]]&mdash;that were [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] by the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Species/Legends|species]] utilized [[boron power generator]]s.<ref name="Shantipole" /> A [[boron fission reactor]] was used to power the [[Loronar Defense Industries]] [[Turbolaser System I]] [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] emplacement; however, it had a tendency to overheat.<ref name="IS2" />

===Missiles===
{{Quote|And how about the boron missile specs we sent? I'm sure ''those'' have proven useful. The Imperials are certainly puzzled by its sudden ineffectiveness.|[[Emala]], to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="Insider67">{{InsiderCite|67|The Trouble with Squibs}}</ref>}}
[[File:Sienar.svg|thumb|right|180px|Sienar Fleet Systems (logo pictured) used boron in the manufacture of MS-15 diamond boron missiles.]]
Boron was also used in the manufacture of [[Missile/Legends|missiles]].<ref name="Insider67" /> By 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of {{InsiderCite|65|The Pengalan Tradeoff}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] was manufacturing experimental anti-[[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[diamond boron missile]]s at a factory on<ref name="Insider65">{{InsiderCite|65|The Pengalan Tradeoff}}</ref> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> planet [[Pengalan IV]]. When, during a [[Battle of Pengalan IV|mission]] to the facility, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] [[Joram Kithe]] noticed a mention of a cargo of test missiles labeled as type [[AS-X-DB]] amid the Confederacy's data, he assumed that the designation "DB" stood for "[[Diamond/Legends|Diamond]] Boron."<ref name="Insider65" />

The design of the highly destructive [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] anti-starfighter [[MS-15 diamond boron missile]],<ref name="EGWT" /> which was manufactured by [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]],<ref name="3.5 ABY">Per ''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'', the [[MS-15 diamond boron missile]] appears during the events of the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]], the events of which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].</ref> incorporated a diamond boron tip and diamond boron [[Armor/Legends|armor]] blast plates that rendered the missile nearly impervious to [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-mounted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. However, the [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] did not see widespread use due to being prohibitively costly.<ref name="EGWT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The name "boron" was introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise via a mention of a boron power generator in ''[[Strike Force: Shantipole]]'', a [[1988]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure authored by [[Ken Rolston]] and [[Steve Gilbert]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Shantipole" /> [[Steve Perry]]'s [[1996]] novel [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'']] subsequently provided the first identification of boron as a distinct material.<ref name="SotE" /> When an expanded version of<ref name="Acilaris" /> the section of [[Robert Wiese]] and [[Andy Collins]]' [[2001]] ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' focusing on the planet Acilaris<ref name="LFCG" /> was published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[April 9]], [[2003]], it [[Retroactive continuity|retroactively]] established<ref name="Acilaris" /> that boron had also been indirectly mentioned in the original section as well.<ref name="Acilaris" /><ref name="LFCG" />

[[File:BoronRealWorld.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A sample of real-world crystalline boron]]
In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Boron|boron]] is a [[Wikipedia:Chemical element|chemical element]] and [[Wikipedia:Metalloid|metalloid]], that, in its pure [[Wikipedia:Allotropes of boron|crystalline form]], has a black [[Wikipedia:Lustre (mineralogy)|luster]] and is hard but brittle. In nature, boron has low abundance and is predominantly found in the form of [[Wikipedia:Chemical compound|chemical compounds]]. Boron is used to increase hardness in [[Wikipedia:Steel|steel]], and it combines with various [[Wikipedia:Metal|metals]] to form a class of compounds called [[Wikipedia:Boride|borides]], with some of the latter being among the hardest and the most heat-resistant of all known substances.<ref name="BoronBritannica">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/science/boron-chemical-element|text=Boron &#124; Properties, Uses, & Facts|author=The Editors of Encyclopædia Britannica|date=2024-11-11|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|''Encyclopædia Britannica'']]|archivedate=20241224193343}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:Boron carbide|Boron carbide]] and [[Wikipedia:Boron nitride|boron nitride]] are the hardest known materials after [[Wikipedia:Diamond|diamond]], with boron carbide being used in the manufacture of military armor.<ref name="BoronCarbideBritannica">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/science/boron-carbide|text=Boron carbide &#124; Hardness, Abrasion Resistance, Refractory|author=The Editors of Encyclopædia Britannica|date=2010-04-14|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|''Encyclopædia Britannica'']]|archivedate=20240619042932}}</ref>
